questionText: Q1. What is the worst-case time complexity of finding the k-th smallest element in an unsorted array of n elements using the QuickSelect (Median of Medians) algorithm?
explanation: Using the Median of Medians deterministic pivot selection rule, the recurrence is T(n) <= T(n/5) + T(7n/10) + O(n), which solves to O(n) linear time in the worst case.
sourceReference: GATE CS Paper 4 — Digital Logic & Computer Architecture
